# Benchmark results

Generated by the Go benchmark runner. Scores are from the candidate's perspective.
Completed score excludes unfinished games. Possible score treats unfinished games as all losses through all wins; it is not a confidence interval.
Forfeits count as losses for the offending engine. Compare matching profiles before interpreting progress.
